mapper.sql: case when trim(s.grade_name) in ('一年级', '小学一年级', '小一', '1年级') then 0 when trim(s.grade_name) in ('二年级', '小学二年级', '小二', '2年级') then 1 when trim(s.grade_name) in ('三年级', '小学三年级', '小三', '3年级') then 2 when trim(s.grade_name) in ('四年级', '小学四年级', '小四', '4年级') then 3 when trim(s.grade_name) in ('五年级', '小学五年级', '小五', '5年级') then 4 when trim(s.grade_name) in ('六年级', '小学六年级', '小六', '6年级') then 5 when trim(s.grade_name) in ('初一', '初中一年级', '七年级', '7年级') then 6 when trim(s.grade_name) in ('初二', '初中二年级', '八年级', '8年级') then 7 when trim(s.grade_name) in ('初三', '初中三年级', '九年级', '9年级') then 8 when trim(s.grade_name) in ('高一', '高中一年级') then 9 when trim(s.grade_name) in ('高二', '高中二年级') then 10 when trim(s.grade_name) in ('高三', '高中三年级') then 11 when s.grade_name is null or trim(s.grade_name) in ('', '未分年级') then 100 else 99 end

select s.schedule_id as scheduleId, s.course_class_name as courseClassName, s.grade_name as gradeName, s.subject_name as subjectName, coalesce(nullif(trim(teacher.user_name), ''), nullif(trim(teacher.nick_name), ''), s.teacher_name) as teacherName, s.class_type as classType, s.class_mode as classMode, s.lesson_location as lessonLocation, s.course_year as courseYear, s.term_name as termName, s.period_name as periodName, s.time_slot as timeSlot, s.start_time as startTime, s.end_time as endTime, s.start_date as startDate, s.end_date as endDate, s.class_pattern as classPattern, s.recruit_status as recruitStatus, s.status, ifnull(s.enrolled_count, 0) as enrolledCount, c.classroom_name as classroomName, c.campus_name as campusName from edu_course_schedule s left join sys_user teacher on teacher.user_id = s.teacher_id left join edu_classroom c on c.classroom_id = s.classroom_id
mapper.select: select grade_name from ( select distinct s.grade_name, as grade_sort from edu_course_schedule s where s.del_flag = '0' and s.grade_name is not null and s.grade_name != '' ) grades order by grade_sort, grade_name

select r.class_date as classDate, r.sign_status as signStatus, r.review_status as reviewStatus, r.source_type as sourceType, r.remark from edu_class_sign_in r join edu_enrollment e on e.enrollment_id = r.enrollment_id and e.schedule_id = r.schedule_id join edu_course_schedule s on s.schedule_id = r.schedule_id where r.enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId} and r.del_flag = '0' and e.del_flag = '0' and s.del_flag = '0' and s.teacher_id = #{teacherId} order by r.class_date desc, r.sign_in_id desc

select class_date as classDate, sign_status as signStatus, review_status as reviewStatus, source_type as sourceType, remark from edu_class_sign_in where enrollment_id = #{enrollmentId} and del_flag = '0' order by class_date desc, sign_in_id desc
